source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1.Enter BIOS -> Server Mgmt page -> View FRU information.
2. Check information.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. All information should match SPEC definition.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- View FRU information: read the FRU information ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" fru print 2>&1 and the Server Mgmt FRU page content.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the full `ipmitool fru print` so the user confirms the chassis/board/product FRU fields are populated and correct.

original_test_intent: Visually verify that every FRU field displayed on BIOS Server Mgmt -> View FRU information matches the owner-approved specification.
original_method: Confirm the target and FRU specification, capture the BIOS FRU page, collect complete read-only BMC FRU data for corroboration, map labels field by field, and record all mismatches without changing FRU content.
manual_activity: A human must navigate to and visually inspect the BIOS FRU page. The agent may collect and compare IPMI FRU data, but cannot claim that the BIOS page displayed the same values.
required_inputs: BIOS console operator and capture method
safety_requirements: Use read-only BIOS observation and ipmitool fru print only; never issue FRU write/edit commands.
Confirm the BMC endpoint before collection and avoid credentials in stored command lines.
Preserve complete raw output and unedited BIOS captures.
Stop on target mismatch, accidental edit/write path or management instability.
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete read-only ipmitool fru print output and platform identity after approval.
Normalize and compare mapped fields with the supplied SPEC and BIOS captures.
Report missing, blank and mismatched fields without issuing the engineer verdict.
engineer_actions: Supply/approve expected fields and optional-field policy.
Capture the BIOS Server Mgmt FRU page without changing settings.
Resolve legitimate representation differences and decide PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Relevant as corroborating read-only BMC evidence, but it does not read the BIOS page and populated values are not proof of SPEC correctness.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain full ipmitool fru print against the confirmed BMC with credential-safe handling; do not add a write command or truncate output.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BIOS Server Mgmt path, no-script state and 10/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a chassis/board/product comparison table that preserves raw BIOS labels and raw IPMI output, then applies only approved whitespace, unit and optional-field normalization before comparing with the SPEC.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, BMC and ipmitool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner FRU specification and platform field map.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds structured machine-readable corroboration while retaining the required BIOS visual check.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BIOS may omit or relabel fields available in IPMI; only approved mappings are valid.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define which optional FRU fields are applicable and their expected values. Supplying the SPEC makes the case ready; it does not change MANUAL ONLY or permit IPMI output to replace BIOS evidence.
expected_evidence: Target/firmware identity and approved FRU specification
Complete raw ipmitool fru print output
Timestamped BIOS FRU-page captures covering every displayed field
Field mapping and expected-to-actual comparison including blanks
Post-collection management health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure and criterion consistently require BIOS-displayed FRU values to match a SPEC. The unspecified project values and field list are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intent is clear and manually observable. Missing SPEC, mapping, credentials or console delays execution but does not permanently block the library case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its useful read-only command only as corroboration and rejects populated-as-correct reasoning.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its field mapping and evidence controls but reclassifies to MANUAL ONLY because observing the BIOS page is core acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates UI evidence, automated comparison and engineer verdict while preserving all original fields and timing.

review_improvement: Turns a vague populated-output check into a traceable per-field SPEC comparison without falsely claiming command output proves BIOS presentation.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source names a BIOS page as the object under test. IPMI FRU data can expose the backing inventory but not what the BIOS rendered; because the decisive observation is manual, V3.1 requires MANUAL ONLY.
no_automatic_retry: Do not re-enter BIOS or repeat collection automatically after a mismatch; retain raw evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
